title.zh: 卷二十七 志第八: 河渠 黃河 漕渠盧溝河 滹沱河 漳河
title.en: Volume 27 Treatises 8: Rivers and Canals - Yellow River and its Branches and Channels, Hutuo River, Zhang River
title.raw: 卷二十七 志第八: 河渠 黃河 漕渠盧溝河 滹沱河 漳河 Volume 27 Treatises 8: Rivers and Canals - Yellow River and its Branches and Channels, Hutuo River, Zhang River

sentences.zh: 金始克宋，兩河悉畀劉豫。

translations.literal: When Jin first conquered Song, both He Rivers were all entrusted to Liu Yu.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin first overran the Song, both banks of the Yellow River were handed entirely to Liu Yu.

sentences.zh: 豫亡，河遂盡入金境。

translations.literal: When Yu perished, the river then entirely entered Jin territory.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu fell, the river and its works lay wholly within Jin borders.

sentences.zh: 數十年間，或決或塞，遷徙無定。

translations.literal: Over several decades, sometimes breaching, sometimes blocked, shifting without fixed course.
translations.idiomatic: For decades it broke out or was dammed, its channel wandering without fixed line.

sentences.zh: 金人設官置屬，以主其事。

translations.literal: Jin people established offices and set subordinates to oversee the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin set up offices and staff to take charge of the work.

sentences.zh: 沿河上下凡二十五埽，六在河南，十九在河北，埽設散巡河官一員。

translations.literal: Along the river above and below were twenty-five sao in all—six south of the river, nineteen north of the river—each sao having one roving river-patrol official.
translations.idiomatic: Along the full reach of the river stood twenty-five levee sections—six south of the stream, nineteen north—each with a roving river-patrol officer.

sentences.zh: 雄武、滎澤、原武、陽武、延津五埽則兼汴河事，設黃汴都巡河官一員于河陰以蒞之。

translations.literal: The five sao Xiongwu, Yingze, Yuanwu, Yangwu, and Yanjin also handled Bian River affairs; one Combined Huang-Bian regional river-patrol director was set at Heyin to oversee them.
translations.idiomatic: Xiongwu, Yingze, Yuanwu, Yangwu, and Yanjin also oversaw the Bian Canal; a single Combined Huang-Bian regional director at Heyin supervised them.

sentences.zh: 懷州、孟津、孟州及城北之四埽則兼沁水事，設黃沁都巡河官一員於懷州以臨之。

translations.literal: Huaizhou, Mengjin, Mengzhou, and the four sao north of the city wall also handled Qin River affairs; one Combined Huang-Qin regional director was set at Huaizhou to face them.
translations.idiomatic: Huaizhou, Mengjin, Mengzhou, and the four north-city sao shared Qin River duty; a Combined Huang-Qin director at Huaizhou watched over them.

sentences.zh: 崇福上下、衛南、淇上四埽屬衛南都巡河官，則居新鄉。

translations.literal: Upper and Lower Chongfu, Weinan, and Qishang four sao belonged to the Weinan regional river-patrol director, who resided at Xinxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Upper and Lower Chongfu, Weinan, and Qishang fell under the Weinan regional director, based at Xinxiang.

sentences.zh: 武城、白馬、書城、教城四埽屬浚滑都巡河官，則處教城。

translations.literal: Wucheng, Baima, Shucheng, and Jiaocheng four sao belonged to the Xun-Hua regional river-patrol director, who was stationed at Jiaocheng.
translations.idiomatic: Wucheng, Baima, Shucheng, and Jiaocheng answered to the Xun-Hua regional director at Jiaocheng.

sentences.zh: 曹甸都巡河官則總東明、西佳、孟華、淩城四埽。

translations.literal: The Caodian regional river-patrol director then oversaw Dongming, Xijia, Menghua, and Lingcheng four sao.
translations.idiomatic: The Caodian regional director commanded Dongming, Xijia, Menghua, and Lingcheng.

sentences.zh: 曹濟都巡河官則司定陶、濟北、寒山、金山四埽者也。

translations.literal: The Cao-Ji regional river-patrol director was the one who administered Dingtao, Jibei, Hanshan, and Jinshan four sao.
translations.idiomatic: The Cao-Ji regional director ran Dingtao, Jibei, Hanshan, and Jinshan.

sentences.zh: 故都巡河官凡六員。

translations.literal: Thus regional river-patrol directors numbered six in all.
translations.idiomatic: In all there were six regional river-patrol directors.

sentences.zh: 後又特設崇福上下埽都巡河官兼石橋使。

translations.literal: Later a special Upper and Lower Chongfu sao regional river-patrol director was also set, concurrently Stone Bridge commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Later they added a dedicated director for Upper and Lower Chongfu, who also served as Stone Bridge commissioner.

sentences.zh: 凡巡河官，皆從都水監廉舉，總統埽兵萬二千人，歲用薪百一十一萬三千餘束，草百八十三萬七百餘束，樁杙之木不與，此備河之恆制也。

translations.literal: All river-patrol officials were selected through integrity screening by the Directorate of Waterways, commanding twelve thousand sao troops; annual use was 1,113,000-odd bundles of firewood, 1,837,000-odd bundles of grass, pile and stake timber not included—this was the standing system for river preparedness.
translations.idiomatic: Every patrol officer came up through the Directorate of Waterways' integrity screening, commanding twelve thousand sao troops. Each year the works consumed over 1.11 million bundles of fuel wood and over 1.83 million bundles of thatch, not counting piling timber—standing river-defense scale.

sentences.zh: 大定八年六月，河決李固渡，水潰曹州城，分流于單州之境。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of Dading 8 the river breached at Ligudu; water burst Caozhou city and divided within Danzhou territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Dading 8 the river broke at Ligudu, flooding Caozhou and splitting across Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，朝廷遣都水監梁肅往視之。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 9 the court sent Directorate of Waterways director Liang Su to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: The first month of year 9 the court sent Liang Su of the Directorate of Waterways to inspect.

sentences.zh: 河南統軍使宗室宗敘言：「大河所以決溢者，以河道積淤，不能受水故也。

translations.literal: Henan military commissioner of the imperial clan Zong Xu said: "The great river overflows and breaches because the channel has silted up and cannot take the water.
translations.idiomatic: Henan military commissioner Zong Xu of the imperial clan said: "The Yellow River breaches because the bed is choked with silt and will not hold the flow.

sentences.zh: 今曹、單雖被其患，而兩州本以水利為生，所害農田無幾。

translations.literal: Now Cao and Dan, though stricken, originally lived by waterworks; farmland harmed is slight.
translations.idiomatic: "Cao and Dan suffer, yet both counties live by hydraulic labor—the cropland lost is small.

sentences.zh: 今欲河複故道，不惟大費工役，又卒難成功。

translations.literal: Now to wish the river return to the old course is not only greatly costly in labor, but also suddenly hard to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: To force the river back into its old bed would cost enormous labor and still fail at once.

sentences.zh: 縱能塞之，他日霖潦，亦將潰決，則山東河患又非曹、單比也。

translations.literal: Even if it could be blocked, another day of heavy rain and flood would breach again, and then Shandong's river calamity would not compare to Cao and Dan.
translations.idiomatic: Even if sealed, the next cloudburst would burst it again—and Shandong's flood would dwarf what Cao and Dan see now.

sentences.zh: 又沿河數州之地，驟興大役，人心動搖，恐宋人乘間構為邊患。

translations.literal: Moreover along the river several prefectures, suddenly raising great works, hearts shaken—fearing Song might seize the interval and stir border trouble."
translations.idiomatic: Along the river, sudden mass corvée would shake the people; the Song might use the unrest to raid the frontier."

sentences.zh: 」而肅亦言：「新河水六分，舊河水四分，今若塞新河，則二水複合為一。

translations.literal: And Su also said: "New river water six parts, old river water four parts; if now the new river is blocked, then the two waters reunite as one.
translations.idiomatic: Su added: "The new channel carries six-tenths of the flow, the old four. Block the new stream and both become one.

sentences.zh: 如遇漲溢，南決則害于南京，北決'則山東、河北皆被其害。

translations.literal: If meeting flood swell, south breach then harms Nanjing, north breach then Shandong and Hebei all suffer its harm.
translations.idiomatic: At flood stage a southern break would drown Nanjing; a northern break would wash Shandong and Hebei alike.

sentences.zh: 不若李固南築堤以防決溢為便。

translations.literal: Better south of Ligu build embankment to guard against breach overflow is convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Better to build a dike south of Ligu against breakout—that is the prudent course."

sentences.zh: 」尚書省以聞，上從之。

translations.literal: The Secretariat reported; the emperor followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat memorialized; the throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 十年三月，拜宗敘為參知政事，上諭之曰：「卿昨為河南統軍時，嘗言黃河堤埽利害，甚合朕意。

translations.literal: In the third month of year 10 Zong Xu was appointed participation councillor; the emperor instructed him: "You yesterday as Henan military commissioner spoke of Yellow River dike and sao harm and benefit, very fitting Our mind.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, year 10: Zong Xu became participation councillor. The emperor told him: "As Henan commander you once laid out the Yellow River dikes and sao—exactly what I needed.

sentences.zh: 朕每念百姓凡有差調，吏互為奸，若不早計而迫期征斂，則民增十倍之費。

translations.literal: We every think of the people—whenever there is corvée, clerks cheat one another; if not planned early but forced collection at deadline, the people pay tenfold the cost.
translations.idiomatic: I think constantly of the people: every levy breeds clerkish fraud; wait until the deadline and the cost multiplies tenfold.

sentences.zh: 然其所征之物，或委積經年，至腐朽不可複用，使吾民數十萬之財，皆為棄物，此害非細。

translations.literal: Yet what is collected may be piled years until rotten and unusable again, making Our people's wealth of hundreds of thousands all waste—this harm is not slight.
translations.idiomatic: What they seize often rots in storehouses for years—tens of thousands in wealth turned to trash. That harm is not small.

sentences.zh: 卿既參朝政，凡類此者皆當革其弊，擇所利而行之。

translations.literal: You now join court governance; wherever like this, all should reform its abuses and choose what profits to execute."
translations.idiomatic: You sit in council now—root out such abuses and keep only what truly serves the realm."

sentences.zh: 」十一年，河決王村，南京孟、衛州界多被其害。

translations.literal: In year 11 the river breached at Wangcun; Nanjing, Meng, and Weizhou borders mostly suffered.
translations.idiomatic: Year 11 the river broke at Wangcun; Nanjing and the Meng and Wei frontier bore the brunt.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月，尚書省奏：「檢視官言，水東南行，其勢甚大。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 12 the Secretariat memorialized: "Inspection officials say the water runs southeast, its force very great.
translations.idiomatic: First month, year 12: the Secretariat reported that inspectors found the current driving southeast with violent force.

sentences.zh: 可自河陰廣武山循河而東，至原武、陽武、東明等縣孟、衛等州增築堤岸，日役夫萬一千，期以六十日畢。

translations.literal: From Heyin Guangwu Mountain along the river east to Yuanwu, Yangwu, Dongming counties and Meng, Wei prefectures, raise dike banks; daily corvée ten thousand one hundred, term sixty days to finish."
translations.idiomatic: They proposed a dike from Heyin's Guangwu Mountain east along the river through Yuanwu, Yangwu, Dongming, and the Meng and Wei prefectures—11,000 laborers a day, sixty days to finish."

sentences.zh: 」詔遣太府少監張九思、同知南京留守事紇石烈邈小字阿補孫監護工作。

translations.literal: An edict sent Palace Storehouse vice director Zhang Jiusi and Nanjing deputy defender Wanyan Yaosun (courtesy name Aibusun) to supervise the work.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Zhang Jiusi of the Palace Storehouse and Nanjing deputy defender Wanyan Yaosun (courtesy Aibusun) to supervise.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月，以尚書省請修孟津、滎澤、崇福埽堤以備水患，上乃命雄武以下八埽並以類從事。

translations.literal: In the third month of year 13, because the Secretariat requested repair of Mengjin, Yingze, and Chongfu sao dikes against water calamity, the emperor then ordered Xiongwu and the seven sao below to follow suit by category.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, year 13: at the Secretariat's request to repair Mengjin, Yingze, and Chongfu sao dikes, the throne ordered Xiongwu and seven sao downstream to do the same.

sentences.zh: 十七年秋七月，大雨，河決白溝。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, year 17, great rain; the river breached at Baigou.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, year 17: heavy rains; the river broke at Baigou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，尚書省奏：「修築河堤，日役夫一萬一千五百，以六十日畢工。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Secretariat memorialized: "Building river dikes, daily corvée eleven thousand five hundred, to finish work in sixty days."
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: the Secretariat proposed river dikes at 11,500 workers a day, sixty-day completion.

sentences.zh: 」詔以十八年二月一日發六百里內軍夫，並取職官人力之半，餘聽發民夫，以尚書工部郎中張大節、同知南京留守事高蘇董役。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that on the first day of the second month of year 18, within six hundred li, army corvée and half the clerical manpower be levied; the rest might be civilian corvée; Works Bureau director Zhang Dajie and Nanjing deputy defender Gao Su would direct the labor.
translations.idiomatic: Year 18, second month, first day: corvée within six hundred li—troops plus half the official staff, the rest civilians—under Zhang Dajie of the Works Bureau and Nanjing deputy Gao Su.

sentences.zh: 先是，祥符縣陳橋鎮之東至陳留潘崗，黃河堤道四十餘里以縣官攝其事，南京有司言，乞專設埽官，十九年九月，乃設京埽巡河官一員。

translations.literal: Earlier, from east of Chenqiao town in Xiangfu county to Pan hillock in Chenliu, forty-odd li of Yellow River dike road were handled by county officials; Nanjing authorities asked a dedicated sao officer; in the ninth month of year 19 one Jing sao river-patrol officer was set.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, forty-odd li of Yellow River dike from Chenqiao in Xiangfu east to Pan hillock in Chenliu had been run by county deputies; Nanjing asked for a dedicated sao officer—in the ninth month of year 19 a Jing sao patrol officer was appointed.

sentences.zh: 二十年，河決衛州及廷津京東埽，彌漫至於歸德府。

translations.literal: In year 20 the river breached Weizhou and Tingjin Jingdong sao, spreading to Guide Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Year 20: breaches at Weizhou and Tingjin Jingdong sao flooded as far as Guide Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 檢視官南京副留守石抹輝者言：「河水因今秋霖潦暴漲，遂失故道，勢益南行。

translations.literal: Inspector Nanjing deputy defender Shimo Hui said: "River water because this autumn's rain flood swelled violently, then lost the old course, force increasingly running south."
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Shimo Hui, Nanjing deputy defender, reported: "Autumn floods drove the river out of its old bed; the current is shoving ever farther south."

sentences.zh: 」宰臣以聞。

translations.literal: Chancellors reported.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellors memorialized.

sentences.zh: 乃自衛州埽下接歸德府南北兩岸增築堤以捍湍怒，計工一百七十九萬六千餘，日役夫二萬四千餘，期以七十日畢工。

translations.literal: Then from Weizhou sao down connecting Guide Prefecture north and south both banks, raise dikes to resist turbulent rage; labor reckoned 1,796,000-odd, daily corvée twenty-four thousand-odd, term seventy days to finish.
translations.idiomatic: They raised dikes from Weizhou sao down along both banks of Guide—1,796,000-odd work units, 24,000 laborers a day, seventy days.

sentences.zh: 遂於歸德府創設巡河官一員，埽兵二百人，且詔頻役夫之地與免今年稅賦。

translations.literal: Then at Guide Prefecture one river-patrol officer was newly set, sao troops two hundred; also an edict that places frequently levying corvée were exempted this year's tax and levies.
translations.idiomatic: Guide gained a new patrol officer and two hundred sao troops; corvée districts were excused that year's taxes.

sentences.zh: 二十一年十月，以河移故道，命築堤以備。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of year 21, because the river shifted the old course, an order to build dikes against it.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, year 21: the river had left its old bed—orders to build protective dikes.

sentences.zh: 二十六年八月，河決衛州堤，壞其城。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of year 26 the river breached Weizhou dike and destroyed its city.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, year 26: the river broke Weizhou's dike and wrecked the city.

sentences.zh: 上命戶部侍郎王寂、都水少監王汝嘉馳傳措畫備禦。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Revenue vice director Wang Ji and Directorate of Waterways vice director Wang Rujia to rush by post to plan defenses.
translations.idiomatic: The throne sent Wang Ji of Revenue and Wang Rujia of the Directorate of Waterways post-haste to organize defenses.

sentences.zh: 而寂視被災之民不為拯救，乃專集眾以網魚取官物為事，民甚怨嫉。

translations.literal: But Ji, viewing the stricken people, did not save them; he only gathered crowds to net fish for government goods, and the people greatly resented.
translations.idiomatic: Ji ignored the drowning counties and set men to net fish for the treasury; resentment boiled up.

sentences.zh: 上聞而惡之。

translations.literal: The emperor heard and detested it.
translations.idiomatic: Word reached the throne; the emperor was disgusted.

sentences.zh: 既而，河勢氾濫及大名。

translations.literal: Soon after, river force flooded and overflowed as far as Daming.
translations.idiomatic: The flood soon spread to Daming.

sentences.zh: 上於是遣戶部尚書劉瑋往行工部事，從宜規畫，黜寂為蔡州防禦使。

translations.literal: The emperor then sent Revenue director Liu Wei to act Works affairs, act as expedient, and demoted Ji to Caizhou defender.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Liu Wei of Revenue to handle Works matters with full discretion and demoted Ji to defender of Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，上謂宰臣曰：「朕聞亡宋河防一步置一人，可添設河防軍數。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, the emperor told the chancellors: "We hear the fallen Song placed one man every step on river defense—river-defense troops may be added."
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month: the emperor told his ministers, "I hear the fallen Song posted one man every pace along the dikes—we should enlarge the river-defense corps."

sentences.zh: 」它日，又曰：「比聞河水泛溢，民罹其害者，貲產皆空。

translations.literal: Another day he also said: "Recently We hear river water overflowed, people suffering its harm—all property empty.
translations.idiomatic: Another day he said: "The floods have emptied people's stores—why

sentences.zh: 今複遣官于被災路分推排，何耶？

translations.literal: Now again sending officials on stricken routes to assess—why?"
translations.idiomatic: send assessors down the disaster routes to squeeze more?"

sentences.zh: 」右丞張汝霖曰：「今推排者皆非被災之處。

translations.literal: Right vice director Zhang Rulin said: "Those now assessed are all not stricken places."
translations.idiomatic: Vice director Zhang Rulin said: "The assessments aren't even hitting the flooded districts."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「雖然，必其鄰道也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Although so, surely neighboring circuits."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Even so—they border the water.

sentences.zh: 既鄰水而居，豈無驚擾遷避者乎？

translations.literal: Already neighboring water and dwelling, how without alarm, disturbance, flight, and avoidance?
translations.idiomatic: Live beside the river and nobody flees or panics?

sentences.zh: 計其貲產，豈有餘哉！

translations.literal: Reckoning their property, how could there be surplus!
translations.idiomatic: Count their goods—what surplus remains?

sentences.zh: 尚何推排為。

translations.literal: Still why assess.
translations.idiomatic: Why assess at all?"

sentences.zh: 」十一月，又謂宰臣曰：「河未決衛州時嘗有言者，既決之後，有司何故不令朕知。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he again told the chancellors: "Before the river breached Weizhou there were those who spoke; after it breached, why did officials not let Us know."
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: "Before Weizhou broke, someone warned me. After the breach, why was I kept in the dark?"

sentences.zh: 」命詢其故。

translations.literal: An order to inquire the reason.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered an inquiry.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月，尚書省言：「鄭州河陰縣聖後廟，前代河水為患，屢禱有應，嘗加封號廟額。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring, year 27, the Secretariat said: "Zhengzhou Heyin county Sheng Hou temple—former dynasties river water was calamity, repeated prayer had response, once added title and temple plaque.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, first month, year 27: the Secretariat reported that at Heyin in Zhengzhou, Sheng Hou's temple—

sentences.zh: 今因禱祈，河遂安流，乞加褒贈。

translations.literal: Now because of prayer the river then peacefully flowed; beg added praise and gift."
translations.idiomatic: prayer had calmed the river; they asked to renew the honors."

sentences.zh: 」上從其請，特加號曰昭應順濟聖後，廟曰靈德善利之廟。

translations.literal: The emperor followed the request, specially adding title Zhao Ying Shun Ji Sheng Hou, temple Ling De Shan Li zhi Miao.
translations.idiomatic: The throne agreed, adding the title "Manifest Responsive Smooth-Flowing Sacred Queen" and naming the temple "Temple of Spiritual Virtue and Beneficent Profit."

sentences.zh: 二月，以衛州新鄉縣令張虡、丞唐括唐古出、主簿溫敦偎喝，以河水入城閉塞救護有功，皆遷賞有差。

translations.literal: In the second month, because Weizhou Xinxiang magistrate Zhang Xu, aide Tangut Tangguchu, and registrar Wendun Weina, for river water entering the city blocking and rescue having merit, all were promoted and rewarded by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Xinxiang magistrate Zhang Xu, aide Tangut Tangguchu, and registrar Wendun Weina earned graded promotions for sealing the breach when the river drove into the city.

sentences.zh: 御史台言：「自來沿河京、府、州、縣官坐視管內河防缺壤，特不介意。

translations.literal: The Censorate said: "From old, along-river capital, prefecture, and county officials sat viewing within their jurisdiction river-defense gaps and breaches, especially not minding.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate said: "River officials have long watched gaps in the dikes inside their jurisdictions and shrugged.

sentences.zh: 若令沿河京、府、州縣長貳官皆于名銜管勾河防事，如任內規措有方能禦大患，或守護不謹以致疏虞，臨時聞奏，以議賞罰。

translations.literal: If ordered that along-river capital, prefecture, and county chief and vice officials all in their name titles oversee river-defense affairs—if within term planning had ability and could ward great calamity, or guarding not carefully and causing negligence, reported at the time to discuss reward and punishment."
translations.idiomatic: Put river defense in the chief and vice magistrates' titles: reward those who hold a breach; punish negligence reported in time."

sentences.zh: 」上從之，仍命每歲將泛之時，令工部官一員沿河檢視。

translations.literal: The emperor followed it, still ordering each year when floods approach, one Works Bureau official to inspect along the river.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed and ordered a Works Bureau inspector along the river each flood season.

sentences.zh: 於是以南京府及所屬延津、封丘、祥符、開封、陳留、胙城、杞縣、長垣、歸德府及所屬宋城、甯陵、虞城，河南府及孟津，河中府及河東，懷州河內、武陟，同州朝邑，衛州汲、新鄉、獲嘉、徐州彭城、蕭、豐，孟州河陽、溫，鄭州河陰、滎澤、原武、汜水，浚州衛，陝州閿鄉、湖城、靈寶，曹州濟陰，滑州白馬，睢州襄邑，滕州沛，單州單父，解州平陸，開州濮陽，濟州嘉祥、金鄉、鄆城，四府、十六州之長貳皆提舉河防事，四十四縣之令佐皆管勾河防事。

translations.literal: Then Nanjing Prefecture and subordinates Yanjin, Fengqiu, Xiangfu, Kaifeng, Chenliu, Zuo, Qi, Changyuan, Guide Prefecture and subordinates Songcheng, Ningling, Yucheng, Henan Prefecture and Mengjin, Hezhong Prefecture and Hedong, Huaizhou Henei and Wuzhi, Tongzhou Chaoyi, Weizhou Ji and Xinxiang and Huojia, Xuzhou Pengcheng and Xiao and Feng, Mengzhou Heyang and Wen, Zhengzhou Heyin and Yingze and Yuanwu and Sishui, Xunzhou Wei, Shanzhou Min, Hucheng, Lingbao, Caozhou Jiyin, Huazhou Baima, Suizhou Xiangyi, Tengzhou Pei, Danzhou Danfu, Jiezhou Pinglu, Kaizhou Puyang, Jizhou Jiaxiang and Jinxiang and Yancheng—four prefectures, sixteen zhou chiefs and vices all commissioned river defense; forty-four counties' magistrates and aides all oversaw river defense.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing and its counties, Guide and its counties, Henan, Hezhong, Huai, Tong, Wei, Xu, Meng, Zheng, Xun, Shan, Cao, Hua, Sui, Teng, Dan, Jie, Kai, and Ji—chiefs and deputies of four prefectures and sixteen zhou were made river-defense commissioners; magistrates and aides of forty-four counties were made river-defense overseers.

sentences.zh: 初，衛州為河水所壞，乃命增築蘇門，遷其州治。

translations.literal: Earlier, Weizhou was destroyed by river water; then an order to raise Sumen and move its prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the flood had wrecked Weizhou; the court had ordered Sumen raised and the seat moved.

sentences.zh: 至二十八年，水息，居民稍還，皆不樂遷。

translations.literal: By year 28 the water had eased; residents gradually returned, all unwilling to move.
translations.idiomatic: By year 28 the water had fallen back; people drifted home and refused relocation.

sentences.zh: 於是遣大理少卿康元弼按視之。

translations.literal: Then Grand Court of Review vice director Kang Yuanbi was sent to inspect on site.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent Kang Yuanbi of the Grand Court of Review to inspect on site.

sentences.zh: 元弼還奏：「舊州民複業者甚眾，且南使驛道館舍所在，向以不為水備，以故被害。

translations.literal: Yuanbi returned and memorialized: "Old prefecture people returning to livelihood are very many; moreover the southern envoy post road lodge is there—before not prepared for water, therefore suffered harm.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanbi reported: "Many have reopened the old town; the southern envoy post stands there—lack of flood prep caused the ruin.

sentences.zh: 若但修其堤之薄缺者，可以無虞，比之遷治，所省數倍，不若從其民情，修治舊城為便。

translations.literal: If only repair the dike's thin gaps, can be without worry; compared to moving the seat, savings severalfold—better follow the people's feeling and repair the old city."
translations.idiomatic: Patch the thin spots in the dike and we need not fear—far cheaper than moving the seat. Honor the people and rebuild the old walls."

sentences.zh: 」乃不遷州，仍敕自今河防官司怠慢失備者，皆重抵以罪。

translations.literal: Then the seat was not moved; still an edict that from now river-defense offices slack and unprepared would all be heavily punished.
translations.idiomatic: The seat stayed put; slack river officials would face heavy punishment from then on.

sentences.zh: 二十九年五月，河溢于曹州小堤之北。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of year 29 the river overflowed north of Caozhou's small dike.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, year 29: the river topped the small dike north of Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，上諭旨有司曰：「比聞五月二十八日河溢，而所報文字如此稽滯。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the emperor instructed the authorities: "Recently We hear on the twenty-eighth day of the fifth month the river overflowed, yet the report text is so delayed.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: "I hear the river topped on the twenty-eighth of the fifth month—yet your report crawled in.

sentences.zh: 水事最急，功不可緩，稍緩時頃，則難固護矣。

translations.literal: Water affairs are most urgent; work cannot be slow—slightly slow in time and then hard to solidify and guard."
translations.idiomatic: Water work brooks no delay—wait a moment and the levee is lost."

sentences.zh: 」十二月，工部言：「營築河堤，用工六百八萬餘，就用埽兵軍夫外，有四百三十余萬工當用民夫。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Works Bureau said: "Building river dikes, labor 6,080,000-odd; besides using sao troops and army corvée, 4,300,000-odd work must use civilian corvée."
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: Works reported 6.08 million work units for dikes—sao troops and soldiers aside, 4.3 million needed civilians.

sentences.zh: 」遂詔命去役所五百里州、府差顧，於不差夫之地均征顧錢，驗物力科之。

translations.literal: Then an edict ordered prefectures within five hundred li of the works to hire labor; where corvée was not levied, spread hire money evenly; assess by property power.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures within five hundred li were to hire labor; where no corvée was levied, hire fees were spread by property assessment.

sentences.zh: 每工錢百五十交外，日支官錢五十文，米升半。

translations.literal: Each work unit besides one hundred fifty cash wages, daily issued official cash fifty wen, rice one and a half sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Each work unit paid 150 cash plus fifty wen and one and a half sheng of rice per day.

sentences.zh: 仍命彰化軍節度使內族裔、都水少監大齡壽提控五百人往來彈壓。

translations.literal: Still ordered Zhanghua Army military commissioner imperial clansman and Directorate of Waterways vice director Daling Shou to direct five hundred men coming and going to suppress.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansman Daling Shou, Zhanghua Army commissioner and vice director of waterways, was sent with five hundred men to keep order.

sentences.zh: 先是，河南路提刑司言：「沿河居民多困乏逃移，蓋以河防差役煩重故也。

translations.literal: Earlier, Henan circuit judicial commissioner said: "Along-river residents mostly impoverished and fled—probably because river-defense corvée is heavy."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Henan judicial commissioner had said river corvée was driving riverside families into flight.

sentences.zh: 竊惟禦水患者，不過堤埽，若土功從實計料，薪槁樁杙以時征斂，亦複何難。

translations.literal: We consider warding water harm is nothing beyond dike and sao; if earthworks are reckoned honestly and fuel, thatch, piles, and stakes levied on time, what difficulty again.
translations.idiomatic: "Flood defense is dikes and sao—honest earthwork tallies and timely fuel and piling levies should be manageable.

sentences.zh: 今春築堤，都水監初料取土甚近，及其興工乃遠數倍，人夫懼不及程，貴價買土，一隊之間多至千貫。

translations.literal: This spring building dikes, the Directorate first estimated earth very near, yet when work rose it was several times farther; corvée feared missing the deadline, bought earth at dear price—within one team up to a thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: This spring the Directorate estimated borrow-pits nearby; at mobilization the haul was several times farther. Teams missed deadlines and bought soil at a thousand strings a gang.

sentences.zh: 又許州初科薪槁十八萬餘束，既而又配四萬四千，是皆常歲必用之物，農隙均科則易輸納。

translations.literal: Also Xuzhou first levied thatch 180,000-odd bundles, then again apportioned 44,000—these are all yearly necessities; levied evenly in the farming slack would be easy to deliver.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou was levied 180,000 bundles of thatch, then 44,000 more—annual staples better assessed in the slack season.

sentences.zh: 自今堤埽興工，乞令本監以實計度，量一歲所用物料，驗數折稅，或令和買，於冬月分為三限輸納為便。

translations.literal: From now when dike and sao raise work, beg order this Directorate to reckon in fact, measure one year's materials, verify numbers for tax conversion, or order negotiated purchase, in winter months divided in three deadlines to deliver is convenient."
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter let the Directorate measure real need, annual material totals, commuted tax or winter negotiated purchase in three installments."

sentences.zh: 」詔尚書省詳議以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Secretariat to deliberate in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: The throne told the Secretariat to deliberate and report.

sentences.zh: 明昌元年春正月，尚書省奏：「臣等以為，自今凡興工役，先量負土遠近，增築高卑，定功立限，榜諭使人先知，無令增加力役。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring, Mingchang 1, the Secretariat memorialized: "We consider from now whenever raising works, first measure earth-carry distance far and near, raise height high and low, fix labor and set term, post notice so people know beforehand, not allow added corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Mingchang 1, spring: the Secretariat proposed that every project first fix haul distance and lift height, set labor quotas and deadlines, post notices—no surprise corvée.

sentences.zh: 並河防所用物色，委都水監每歲於八月以前，先拘籍舊貯物外實闕之數，及次年春工多寡，移報轉運司計置，於冬三月分限輸納。

translations.literal: Along-river defense materials, entrust the Directorate each year before the eighth month to inventory old stores and true shortfall, and next spring's work scale, report to the transport commissioner to arrange, in winter three months' deadlines to deliver.
translations.idiomatic: River materials: each year before the eighth month the Directorate would inventory stores, report shortfalls and spring work to the transport office, and collect in three winter installments.

sentences.zh: 如水勢不常，夏秋暴漲危急，則用相鄰埽分防備之物，不足，則複於所近州縣和買。

translations.literal: If water force not constant, summer-autumn sudden swell urgent, then use neighboring sao's defense stores; insufficient, then again negotiated purchase in nearest counties.
translations.idiomatic: Summer floods could draw neighboring sao stores; shortfalls would be bought nearby.

sentences.zh: 然複慮人戶道塗泥淖，艱於運納，止依稅內科折他物，更為增價，當官支付，違者並論如律，仍令所屬提刑司正官一員馳驛監視體究，如此則役作有程，而河不失備。

translations.literal: Yet again fearing households' road mud and sludge, hard to transport and deliver, only commuted within tax to other goods with added price, paid by government—violators punished by law; still order the circuit judicial commissioner to post-haste supervise investigation—thus labor has schedule and the river lacks no defense."
translations.idiomatic: Muddy roads might force in-kind tax swaps at markup, paid in cash—violators prosecuted, judicial commissioners riding post to inspect—so work stayed on schedule and the river stayed guarded."

sentences.zh: 」制可之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月，尚書省奏：「河平軍節度使王汝嘉等言：'大河南岸舊有分流河口，如可疏導，足泄其勢，及長堤以北恐亦有可以歸納排瀹之處，乞委官視之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of year 4 the Secretariat memorialized: "He Ping Army military commissioner Wang Rujia and others said: 'South bank of the great river formerly had diversion mouths—if they can be dredged, enough to vent its force; and north of the long dike perhaps also places to receive and scour—beg officials to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, year 4: Wang Rujia of He Ping Army reported that old diversion mouths on the south bank might vent the current; north of the long dike there might be outlets to receive water—he asked for inspection.

sentences.zh: 濟北埽以北宜創起月堤。

translations.literal: North of Jibei sao it is fitting to newly raise moon dikes.'
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed moon dikes north of Jibei sao."

sentences.zh: '臣等以為宜從所言。

translations.literal: We consider it fitting to follow the words.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat favored the plan.

sentences.zh: 其本監官皆以諳練河防故注以是職，當使從汝嘉等同往相視，庶免異議。

translations.literal: These Directorate officials are all posted because skilled in river defense—should make them go with Rujia and others to inspect together, lest different opinions.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled Directorate staff should inspect with Rujia to avoid dispute.

sentences.zh: 如大河南北必不能開挑歸納，其月堤宜依所料興修。

translations.literal: If south and north of the great river truly cannot be opened and dredged to receive, the moon dikes should be raised per estimate."
translations.idiomatic: If diversions proved impossible, moon dikes should be built as estimated."

sentences.zh: 」上從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 十二月，敕都水監官提控修築黃河堤，及令大名府差正千戶一員，部甲軍二百人彈壓勾當。

translations.literal: Now river water trends north, gnawing the long dike in flow at more than ten places, while outside the dike mostly accumulated water—fear hard to rely on original estimates to raise the long dike and newly build moon dikes.
translations.idiomatic: Now the river chewed the long dike in ten-odd places with ponded water outside—raising the long dike and new moon dikes looked doubtful on the old estimates.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月，尚書省奏：「都水監丞田櫟同本監官講議黃河利害，嘗以狀上言，前代每遇古堤南決，多經南、北清河分流，南清河北下有枯河數道，河水流其中者長至七八分，北清河乃濟水故道，可容三二分而已。

translations.literal: Can at north bank Qiang village breach river into Liangshan marsh old course, as before make south and north two Qing rivers divide flow.
translations.idiomatic: Li proposed breaching at Qiang village on the north bank into the Liangshan marsh old bed to restore the two Qing rivers.

sentences.zh: 令河水趨北，齧長堤而流者十餘處，而堤外率多積水，恐難依元料增修長堤與創築月堤也。

translations.literal: Now river water trends north, gnawing the long dike in flow at more than ten places, while outside the dike mostly accumulated water—fear hard to rely on original estimates to raise the long dike and newly build moon dikes.
translations.idiomatic: The river was driving north, chewing the long levee in ten-odd places with ponded water outside—raising the long dike and new moon dikes looked doubtful on the old estimates.

sentences.zh: 可於北岸牆村決河入梁山濼故道，依舊作南、北兩清河分流。

translations.literal: Can at north bank Qiang village breach river into Liangshan marsh old course, as before make south and north two Qing rivers divide flow.
translations.idiomatic: Li proposed breaching at Qiang village on the north bank into the Liangshan marsh old bed to restore the two Qing rivers.

sentences.zh: 然北清河舊堤歲久不完，當立年限增築大堤，而梁山故道多有屯田軍戶，亦宜遷徙。

translations.literal: Yet the North Qing River old dike years long incomplete—should set year limits to raise the great dike; Liangshan old course has many garrison-field households, also fitting relocation.
translations.idiomatic: The North Qing's old levee had crumbled for years—they should set a schedule to raise the main dike, and relocate the garrison farms clogging the Liangshan old bed.

sentences.zh: 今擬先于南岸王村、宜村兩處決堤導水，使長堤可以固護，姑宜仍舊，如不能疏導，即依上開決，分為四道，俟見水勢隨宜料理。

translations.literal: Now plan first at south bank Wangcun and Yicun two places breach dike to guide water, so the long dike can be solidly guarded—for the moment still as before; if cannot dredge, then follow the above opening breach, divided into four channels, wait to see water force and handle as fitting.
translations.idiomatic: For now they would breach at Wangcun and Yicun on the south bank to ease the long dike, or—if that failed—open four channels as planned and adapt to the current.

sentences.zh: 」尚書省以櫟等所言與明昌二年劉瑋等所案視利害不同，及令陳言人馮德輿與櫟面對，亦有不合者，送工部議。

translations.literal: The Secretariat said Li and others' words differed from Mingchang 2 Liu Wei and others' on-site harm and benefit inspection; also ordered memorializer Feng Deyu to face Li—also had discrepancies; sent to Works Bureau to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat noted Li's plan clashed with Liu Wei's Mingchang 2 inspection and Feng Deyu's face-to-face review, and referred the dispute to the Works Bureau.

sentences.zh: 複言：「若遽於牆村疏決，緣瀕北清河州縣二十餘處，兩岸連亙千有餘裏，其堤防素不修備，恐所屯軍戶亦卒難徙。

translations.literal: Again reported: "If hastily at Qiang village dredge and breach, bordering North Qing prefectures and counties twenty-odd places, both banks continuous over a thousand-odd li, their dikes long not repaired—fear garrison households also suddenly hard to move.
translations.idiomatic: They warned that a rush breach at Qiang village would threaten twenty-odd North Qing counties along a thousand-odd li of unmended levee and garrisons that could not be moved in time.

sentences.zh: 今歲先于南岸延津縣堤決堤泄水，其北岸長堤自白馬以下，定陶以上，並宜加功築護，庶可以遏將來之患。

translations.literal: This year first at south bank Yanjin county dike breach dike to release water; the north bank long dike from Baima down, Dingtao up, all should add work to build and guard, perhaps can check future calamity.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed breaching Yanjin's south-bank dike this year while strengthening the long levee from Baima to Dingtao against future floods.

sentences.zh: 若定陶以東三埽棄堤則不必修，止決舊壓河口，引導積水東南行，流堤北張彪、白塔兩河間，礙水軍戶可使遷徙，及梁山濼故道分屯者，亦當預為安置。

translations.literal: If east of Dingtao three sao abandon dike then need not repair, only breach old pressed river mouth, guide accumulated water southeast, flow between dike north Zhang Biao and Baita two rivers—obstructing water garrison households can be made to relocate; Liangshan marsh old course divided garrisons also should be pre-arranged for resettlement."
translations.idiomatic: East of Dingtao they would abandon three sao levees, open old mouths, and send ponded water southeast between Zhang Biao and Baita—relocating flooded garrisons and Liangshan settlers in advance."

sentences.zh: 」宰臣奏曰：「若遽從櫟等所擬，恐既更張，利害非細。

translations.literal: Chancellors memorialized: "If hastily follow Li and others' plan, fear already changed, harm and benefit not slight.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellors said sudden adoption of Li's scheme risked great harm.

sentences.zh: 比召河平軍節度使王汝嘉同計議，先差幹濟官兩員行戶工部事覆視之，同則就令計實用工物、量州縣遠近以調丁夫，其督趣春工官即充今歲守漲，及與本監官同議經久之利。

translations.literal: Compared to summoning He Ping Army military commissioner Wang Rujia to plan together, first dispatch two capable officials to act Works affairs and reinspect—if agreed, then reckon real labor and materials, adjust corvée by distance; the spring-work overseers would serve this year's flood watch and with Directorate officials discuss lasting profit."
translations.idiomatic: They would send two capable officers with Wang Rujia to reinspect, then scale labor and corvée, keep spring overseers on flood watch, and seek a lasting plan with the Directorate.

sentences.zh: 」詔以知大名府事內族裔、尚書戶部郎中李敬義充行戶工部事，以參知政事胥持國都提控。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Daming prefect imperial clansman and Revenue director Li Jingyi to act traveling Works affairs, with participation councillor Xu Chiguo as overall director.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingyi, imperial clansman and prefect of Daming, was named acting Works commissioner; Xu Chiguo, participation councillor, directed the effort.

sentences.zh: 又奏差德州防禦使李獻可、尚書戶部郎中焦旭于山東當水所經州縣築護城堤，及北清河兩岸舊有堤處別率丁夫修築，亦就令講究河防之計。

translations.literal: Also memorialized dispatching Dezhou defender Li Xiankai and Revenue director Jiao Xu to Shandong water-route prefectures to build protective city dikes, and at North Qing both banks' old dike places separately levy corvée to repair—also charged to discuss river-defense plans.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiankai of Dezhou and Jiao Xu of Revenue were sent to raise city dikes along Shandong's flood path and repair North Qing levees while studying long-term defense.

sentences.zh: 他日，上以宋閻士良所述《黃河利害》一帙，付參知政事馬琪曰：「此書所言亦有可用者，今以賜卿。

translations.literal: Another day, the emperor because Song Yan Shiliang's narrated Yellow River harm and benefit one fascicle, gave participation councillor Ma Qi, saying: "This book's words also have usable ones—now given to you."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor handed Ma Qi a fascicle on Yellow River policy by the Song writer Yan Shiliang: "Some of this may be useful."

sentences.zh: 」二月，上諭平章政事守貞曰：「王汝嘉、田櫟專管河防，此國家之重事也。

translations.literal: In the second month the emperor instructed Grand Councillor Shouzhen: "Wang Rujia and Tian Li solely manage river defense—this is the state's weighty affair.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: the emperor told Grand Councillor Shouzhen, "Rujia and Li own the river works—a matter of state weight.

sentences.zh: 朕比問其曾于南岸行視否？

translations.literal: We recently asked whether they had inspected the south bank?"
translations.idiomatic: I asked if they had walked the south bank."

sentences.zh: 」乃稱：'未也。

translations.literal: They said: "Not yet."
translations.idiomatic: They said, "Not yet."

sentences.zh: '又問水決能行南岸乎？

translations.literal: Again asked whether water breach could run the south bank?
translations.idiomatic: Could a breach send the river south?

sentences.zh: 又雲：'不可知。

translations.literal: Again said: "Cannot know."
translations.idiomatic: Again: "We cannot know."
